Jynx, Where Gaming Gets Social.

android.desc:
Jynx — Find Teammates & Gaming Friends

Stop solo queue. Find the right teammates for every game.

Jynx is the gaming social app that helps you find teammates, build squads, and connect with gaming friends worldwide. Whether you need a duo partner, a ranked squad, or just people to play with — Jynx matches you with the right players for any multiplayer game.

FIND TEAMMATES INSTANTLY
Stop playing with toxic randoms. Our LFG (Looking For Group) system matches you with gamers who share your playstyle, skill level, and schedule. Find duo partners, squad members, and teammates for any game. No more solo queue — find players who actually communicate and play the objective.

BUILD YOUR GAMING SQUAD
Create or join squads for ranked, casual, or competitive gaming. Coordinate with your gaming friends and build a team that clicks. Whether you're pushing rank or just chilling in multiplayer, find the right squad for every session. Never solo queue again.

GAMING COMMUNITY & SOCIAL
Join a growing community of gamers looking for teammates. Chat, match, and play with people who share your passion for multiplayer gaming. Make gaming friends, join voice chat, and build your network of players you actually want to play with.

SUPPORTED GAMES
Find teammates for the games you actually play. Jynx supports LFG for all major multiplayer titles including Fortnite, Valorant, League of Legends, Call of Duty: Warzone, Apex Legends, Rocket League, Overwatch 2, Minecraft, Roblox, Destiny 2, Rainbow Six Siege, CS2, PUBG, Genshin Impact, and many more. New games added regularly.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose your game and platform
2. Set your rank, playstyle, and availability
3. Get matched with compatible gamers
4. Chat, squad up, and play together

FIND YOUR DUO, FIND YOUR SQUAD
Whether you're looking for a duo partner to climb ranked, a full squad for competitive multiplayer, or just gaming friends to chill with — Jynx is the LFG app built by gamers, for gamers.

Features:
- LFG (Looking For Group) matchmaking for every game
- Find teammates by game, rank, platform, and playstyle
- Duo finder and squad builder
- Gaming chat and social features
- Multiplayer coordination tools
- Filter by skill level, region, and language
- Cross-platform teammate search
- Gaming community with voice chat support

Stop solo queuing with randoms. Find gaming friends, build your squad, and play multiplayer the way it's meant to be played — together.

quotes.text:
TL;DR: Jynx is a gaming social platform that matches you with compatible teammates based on skill level, play style and schedule. Swipe to find players (Tinder-style), create or join game sessions (LFG), chat, and build your squad. 214k lines of Dart, 23 feature modules, built entirely with Claude Code as my entry into agentic engineering.

Live on App Store and Play Store:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.jynx
https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/jynx-where-gaming-gets-social/id6755744762

---

Hi HN, long time lurker, first time poster, be gentle.

Developer by day, vibe coder by night: Jynx is the project I used to ease into agentic engineering.

AI talks are mitigated, at best. But I'll talk about my experience here. Forgive my erratic style, it is what it is.

Working with Claude from the very beginning, it's been a blast. I had the "chance" to have the time necessary to learn and use AI a lot. Lots of different techniques that quickly became completely obsolete today.

Without LLMs, it would have been extremely hard to have the same app than I have today. I used Flutter (Dart) to avoid having to dev and maintain two codebases. It is not a language I knew. Learning the language first would have severely hindered the process.

For me, from copy/paste to using MCP then Roo Code, then Claude Code was an ecstatic process. I always loved having ideas but the time it would take me to build the thing and test it always felt too long. Not anymore.

So we carefully …
